main_public_rating: Variant B: current stance from own event scores, 90-day window, 30-day half-life, camp cuts at ±20 (score on −100..+100). The «vs. Markt» column is a direction only (more hawkish than priced / less hawkish than priced / in line with pricing / n/a). Figures taken from market pricing, proxy series names and the internal market-relative score are not published.
vs_markt_rule: Direction is taken from the sign of the unpublished market-relative current score, using the same ±20 cut as the camps. 'in line with pricing' means that score is between −20 and +20. 'n/a' means the 90-day stance could not be mapped to a market path or the member is not classified. The mapping itself is not validated and was judged not to hold; the column is diagnostic.
official_quote_basis_points: Official-transcript quotes may contain phrases such as '25 basis points' when that is the speaker's own wording. Those hits are not treated as leaks. Figures taken from market pricing, and proxy series names, are forbidden.
lean_history: Monthly 90-day / 30-day-half-life current stance on own scores (Variant B), as-of each month-end from 2025-05-31 through 2026-10-31, plus the as-of date 2026-11-20. Each point records score, camp, n events in that 90-day window, and a provisional flag (n < 4 or no event). The 2026-11-20 point reproduces the published current score. No market-relative values are stored.

camp_thresholds.own_score_main: Hawk > +20, Centrist −20..+20, Dove < −20 (score points; Variant B; not validated)

score_formula: 100 * sum(w_i * d_i for observed i) / sum(w_i for all five dimensions) / 2, with d_i in {-2,-1,0,+1,+2}. Unobserved dimensions are not coded 0; their weights remain in the denominator (shrinkage toward 0).
path_zero: preferred_rate_path 0 is an observed hold / maintain / patient / no-change preference, not a missing value.
trend: current own-score stance minus structural own-score lean; material at ±15 points.
reaction_function: Symmetric rubric: + inflation-first / will not look through; − look-through of transitory inflation or employment-binding reaction.
